manifest.name: dsh-pad
manifest.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件：悬浮面板坞，面板由 AI 在对话里生成并自由分区；支持本机/HTTP 数据源、AI 刷新、面板内 dsh.run 模型调用
manifest.author: ChisaAlter

readme.text:
[](https://github.com/ChisaAlter/dsh-pad/releases)
[](LICENSE)
[](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

**简体中文** · [English](README.en.md)

[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（dsh）的悬浮面板插件。面板由 AI 在对话里生成：比如「做一个观察这台服务器性能的面板」「做一个面板显示我的 DeepSeek API 余额」。

- **悬浮球与自由窗口**：收起时是一颗可拖动的圆形悬浮球（和展开后的收起按钮同位置、同尺寸，颜色跟随主题；两者共用同一枚四瓣星花），可以放在应用里任意位置，靠近窗口四边会自动吸附；点开是面板窗口。窗口拖标题栏可以放到任意位置，拖左边缘调宽度，拖上、下边缘调高度（位置和尺寸都记在浏览器里）。贴住右边缘时，宽屏下仍会给对话区让出位置，右侧面板和回合导航条不会被盖住。
- **AI 生成**：模型通过 `pad_*` 工具创建和修改面板。面板是跑在沙箱 iframe 里的 HTML / CSS / JS，颜色跟随 dsh 的亮色 / 暗色主题。
- **自由分区**：卡片可以拖到另一张卡片的上 / 下 / 左 / 右边缘，在那个位置分出新区域，并且可以继续嵌套——例如左边上下两张、右边一张独立大卡。拖到卡片中间交换位置，拖到面板坞空白处拆成整行。左右分栏的分隔条可以拖动调比例，一行最多 3 张，上下可以叠任意多张。
- **自动检查更新**：启动后在后台查 GitHub 最新 Release（默认每 6 小时）；只有检测到新版本时坞顶才出现下载图标，点开即可更新，重启 dsh 生效。开发目录安装只提示、不覆盖源码。
- **两种取数方式**
  - **直接数据源**：在本机跑 shell 命令，或者从本机请求 HTTP 接口，按秒级间隔刷新，不消耗 token。适合服务器性能、套餐余额这类接口数据。
  - **AI 刷新**：按间隔在后台跑一轮 agent，让它重新取数后提交。适合只能靠搜索、读网页、多步推理才拿得到的数据。
- **面板内模型**：面板里的按钮可以调用 `dsh.run(prompt)`，用这张面板自己的模型跑一次并把结果显示在卡片里；也支持 AI 刷新用同一模型。
- **建好就跑**：数据源不设「允许运行」这一步——面板建好或改好后立刻开始取数，用户不需要在卡片上点任何按钮。也就是说模型写进面板的命令会直接在本机执行，和所有能跑命令的工具一样，请只在信任当前对话的前提下使用。密钥用 `{{env:NAME}}` 引用，只在宿主侧解析，不会发到浏览器。

- **面板 kit**：沙箱 iframe 里预置了一组 `pad-*` 类（`.pad-metric` / `.pad-item` / `.pad-meter` / `.pad-status` / `.pad-spark` …）和 `dsh.ui.metric` / `dsh.ui.list` 之类的生成器。颜色全部走 `--pad-*` 令牌，亮色 / 暗色自动跟随，面板不需要（也不应该）写死颜色。
- **版式手册**：`pad_guide` 把五种版式——单值 + 趋势、排行 / 分布、状态板、额度环、动态列表——和四套完整的 `html` + `script` 配方交给模型，写面板之前先选版式、再写代码。
- **排版检查**：`pad_create` / `pad_update` 会跑一遍确定性的 lint。文字墙、长段落、把 JSON 贴到卡片上、只有文字没有可视元素，直接退回重写；写死颜色、全大写 + 加字距的标签、脚本不处理取数失败，作为警告报给模型。

卡片里的一切仍然由模型写的 HTML / CSS / JS 决定，kit 只是它的起点；lint 拦的是「读不出信息」的排版，不是某种审美。

面板模型参考了 [ChisaBot](https://github.com/ChisaAlter/ChisaBot) 的两种面板：沙箱 HTML 自定义面板，以及机器人定时刷新的实时面板。

在对话里说要什么面板，模型就用 `pad_*` 工具把卡片建出来。三张示例面板分别是：服务器性能（命令数据源，每 3 秒刷新）、最新 Release（HTTP 数据源，解析 GitHub 的 Atom feed）、AI 今日简报（AI 刷新）。 把卡片拖到另一张卡片的上 / 下 / 左 / 右边缘，就在那个位置分出新区域，并且可以继续嵌套——这里左边上下两张、右边一张大卡；分隔条拖动调比例，一行最多 3 张。 收起后是一颗悬浮球，可以拖到窗口任意位置，靠近四边自动吸附，点一下重新展开。 卡片颜色跟着 dsh 的亮色 / 暗色主题走，iframe 里的 CSS 变量会同步切换。

需要 dsh ≥ 0.2.1-rc.2，用 Web 界面（`dsh web`）或鲸屿桌面端。

插件以 **bundle** 方式登记（写进 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`）。**不要**把本仓库 `cordis.patch.yml` 的内容手抄进 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`：那里没有对应的模块解析，启动时整个应用会起不来。

```sh

readme.section: 先自检：lib/ 是否齐全、profile 里有没有残留
readme.text: node scripts/doctor.mjs
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-pad

readme.section: 从 GitHub（仓库里带着构建好的 lib/，不需要跑构建脚本）
readme.text:
dsh plugin --profile web add github:ChisaAlter/dsh-pad#v0.4.5
```

`lib/index.js` 与 `lib/client.js` 是唯一的运行入口，本仓库把它们提交进 git，就是为了让 GitHub 安装不依赖构建脚本（pnpm 会默认拒绝执行依赖的构建脚本）。改了源码就先在插件目录跑 `npm install && npm run build`，再安装。

装好后重启 `dsh web` / 鲸屿。卸载：`dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-pad`。

插件启动后会在后台检查 [GitHub Release](https://github.com/ChisaAlter/dsh-pad/releases)（默认每 6 小时，启动约 7 秒后第一次）。有新版本时：

1. 面板坞顶部出现下载图标（没有新版本时不显示）；
2. 点开，看到当前版本和新版本，点「更新」；
3. 插件先下载并校验完整的 `lib/index.js`、`lib/client.js`、`package.json` 和 `cordis.patch.yml`，备份到 `.dsh-pad-update-backup/`，记录更新事务后再替换；
4. 重启 `dsh web` / 鲸屿后生效。更新中断时，加载入口会先完成已记录的事务；暂存文件损坏会阻止插件加载，避免使用混合版本。

事务恢复从 0.4.5 的更新器开始生效。旧版更新器首次升级到 0.4.5 时仍沿用旧流程，建议关闭应用后安装完整版本。
如果当前是**开发目录链接**安装（插件目录里有 `.git/`），自动更新只提示新版本，不会覆盖源码；请在插件目录执行 `git pull && npm run build`。更新面板里的「重新检查」可以立即查一次；关闭后台检查设 `updateCheck: false`。

装上之后如果鲸屿或 `dsh web` 起不来：

1. 打开 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/package.json`，从 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里删掉 `"dsh-pad"`，并从 `dependencies` 里删掉 `"dsh-pad"`。
2. 打开 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`，删掉任何 `insert` 了 `dsh-pad` 的条目（正常情况下这里不该出现它）。
3. 删掉 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-pad`（它只是一个链接）。
4. 重新启动。
5. 再装之前先跑 `node scripts/doctor.mjs`，它会直接指出是 `lib/` 缺失、链接缺失，还是 profile 补丁被手写了。

直接在对话里说想要什么面板：

> 做一个观察这台服务器性能的面板：CPU、内存、磁盘、负载，每 3 秒刷新
>
> 做一个面板显示我的 DeepSeek API 余额，key 在环境变量 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY 里
>
> 做一个面板盯着 deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness 的最新 release，每 6 小时让 AI 更新一次

面板坞顶部的 **＋** 会把一段「用 `pad_create` 创建自定义面板」的提示词插入当前对话输入框（不会自动发送），接着写你的需求再发送即可。新面板出现时，面板坞会自动展开并高亮这张卡片。

每张卡片的 **⋯** 菜单里有：「让 AI 修改…」（把修改请求填进输入框）、撤销上次修改、面板模型、删除。点卡片标题可以折叠；折叠后的面板不再轮询。

每张卡片左上角的 **六点握把** 可以拖到另一张卡片上：落在左 / 右边缘会分成左右两栏，落在上 / 下边缘会分成上下两区，落在中间会交换两张卡片的位置。分区可以继续嵌套——例如先把三张卡片排成一行，再把中间那张拖到左边卡片的底边，就得到「左边上下两张 + 右边独立一张」。

```text
┌──────────────┬──────────────┐
│ CPU 趋势     │              │
├──────────────┤   网络流量   │
│ 内存         │              │

把卡片拖到面板坞空白处会拆成整行、排到底部。左右分栏的竖分隔条可以拖动调整相邻两栏的宽度比例；新面板单独成行，排在底部。

每张卡片底部有一条细横条：上下拖动可以调整面板高度，双击恢复自动高度；高度按面板记在浏览器里（localStorage），重启后仍然有效。

面板坞本身：拖标题栏可以放到屏幕任意位置（位置记在浏览器里），拖左边缘调宽度，拖上边缘或下边缘调整整体高度（面板列表在内部滚动，双击边缘恢复自动高度，高度也记在浏览器里）。点顶部的收起按钮，面板坞会变成一颗悬浮球，球停在收起按钮原来的位置；展开和收起时星花固定在按钮位置，球面和面板交叉淡入淡出。展开后长按这颗星花可以拖动整个面板窗口，短按仍是收起。球跟随主题、可以用鼠标拖到任意位置，靠近窗口四边会自动吸附，点击重新展开。顶部的 **＋** 用来创建新面板。

`examples/` 下有三份完整的面板定义（服务器性能、DeepSeek 余额、GitHub release），可以当作模型输出的参考。

一张面板的定义：

```jsonc
{
  "title": "服务器性能",
  "icon": "🖥️",
  "html": "…", "css": "…", "script": "…",

- **直接数据源**在展开的卡片或放大视图可见时轮询；所有客户端都关闭、或面板坞收起后停止轮询。命令与 HTTP 输出上限 512KB，默认超时 10 秒；解析后的 JSON 最多 64 层、100,000 个节点。
- **重启后先显示上次的数值**：每个数据源最近一次成功读数、以及最近 20 个点写在 `$DSH_HOME/dsh-pad/readings.json`（10 秒合并写一次，单条 JSON 超过 16KB 不缓存，单个数据源的历史最多留 128KB，数据源改过之后旧读数自动作废）。面板坞一展开就先拿它渲染，趋势图也直接有历史，第一次轮询回来再接着往后画；这个文件只是缓存，删掉只会让面板重新等第一次读数。
- **密钥**：`{{env:NAME}}` 先从 dsh 凭据服务里解析，没有再读宿主进程的环境变量。错误信息里出现的密钥值会被替换成 `***`。带密钥引用、自定义敏感头或请求体的 HTTP 请求只跟随同 origin 重定向；跨 origin 时返回错误，请直接配置可信目标网址。
- **AI 刷新**：后台 agent 默认使用 dsh 的默认模型和默认 agent 预设（有 web_fetch / web_search 等工具），另外只多两个工具：`pad_submit_data` 和 `pad_report_failure`。面板可以带顶层 `model`（`{ provider, model, reasoningEffort? }`）单独指定模型；不写就跟随全局默认。这个模型同时用于面板里的 `dsh.run`。卡片 ⋯ 菜单里的「面板模型」可以直接切换。它只看得到 `instruction` 和上一次提交的数据。单轮最长 5 分钟（可配置），失败后过一段时间重试，原因会显示在卡片上。
- **面板脚本**在 `sandbox="allow-scripts"` 的 iframe 里运行：不和 dsh 同源，CSP 是 `default-src 'none'`，没有网络，拿不到 cookie 和存储，也访问不到父页面。唯一的出口是 `window.dsh`：

| API | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `dsh.onData(fn)` | 有数据时立即调用，之后每次更新再调用。`data = { sources: { [id]: { ok, value, error, at } }, agent: { value, at } \| null }` |
| `dsh.history(id)` | 该数据源最近 120 次成功读数（页面打开期间累积；重启后先带上上次缓存的最近 20 个点），画趋势用 |
| `dsh.refresh()` / `dsh.openUrl(url)` / `dsh.ask(text)` | 立即刷新 / 新标签打开链接 / 把一句话填进对话输入框 |
| `dsh.run(prompt, { system? })` | 用这张面板的模型跑一次，返回 `{ ok, text?, error? }`；纯文本生成，没有工具和网络，适合按钮处理当前数据 |
| `dsh.state.get(k)` / `dsh.state.set(k, v)` | 按面板保存的小量 UI 状态 |
| `dsh.fmt.*` | `bytes` `percent` `number` `ago` `time` `duration` |
| `dsh.chart.*` | `sparkline` `bar` `ring`，返回 SVG / HTML 字符串 |
| `dsh.tone(x)` / `dsh.escape(s)` | 按阈值给出 ok / warn / danger 颜色 / HTML 转义 |

`dsh.run` 只做一次纯文本生成：prompt 最长 2.4 万字，结果最多 3.2 万字，默认 120 秒超时、2048 输出 token；模型来自面板顶层 `model`，没有就跟随全局默认。它不会调用工具；要联网取数，先用直接数据源或 AI 刷新把数据放进面板，再交给 `dsh.run` 处理。`dsh.ask` 仍然是把话交给主对话，不是面板模型。

主题变量：`--pad-fg` `--pad-fg-2` `--pad-fg-3` `--pad-bg` `--pad-bg-2` `--pad-border` `--pad-accent` `--pad-ok` `--pad-warn` `--pad-danger` `--pad-font` `--pad-mono` `--pad-radius`。

给模型的编写手册在 `src/host/guide.ts`：短版作为 `pad_create` 的工具说明常驻，完整版（版式、kit、配方、dsh API）由 `pad_guide` 按需返回。

| 工具 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `pad_list` / `pad_get` | 列出面板 / 读完整定义和最新数据 |
| `pad_guide` | 版式手册：五种版式、kit 类名、完整配方、`dsh` API、取数方式 |
| `pad_test_source` | 试跑一个数据源，先看清输出格式再写脚本 |
| `pad_create` / `pad_update` | 新建 / 修改（只传要改的字段），返回排版检查结果和首次读数 |
| `pad_models` | 列出可用于面板的 provider / 模型 / 推理强度，以及全局默认模型 |
| `pad_refresh` | 立即刷新，并返回读数，修好面板后用来验证 |
| `pad_delete` | 删除 |

在 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` 里覆盖（patch 会替换整个 `config`，写全需要的键）：

```yaml
- id: dsh-pad
  name: dsh-pad
  config:
    minIntervalSec: 2

| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `dataFile` | `$DSH_HOME/dsh-pad/panels.json` | 面板存储位置 |
| `minIntervalSec` | `2` | 直接数据源最短刷新间隔（秒） |
| `agentRefresh` | `true` | 是否允许 AI 刷新的面板 |
| `minAgentMinutes` | `15` | AI 刷新最短间隔（分钟） |
| `agentTimeoutSec` | `300` | 单轮 AI 刷新的最长时间 |
| `agentConcurrency` | `1` | 同时进行的 AI 刷新数量 |
| `agentRetryMinutes` | `15` | AI 刷新失败后的重试间隔 |
| `interactiveModel` | `true` | 是否允许面板按钮通过 `dsh.run` 调用面板模型 |
| `runTimeoutSec` | `120` | 一次 `dsh.run` 的最长时间（秒） |
| `runMaxTokens` | `2048` | 一次 `dsh.run` 最多生成多少 token |
| `runConcurrency` | `2` | 同一张面板同时进行的 `dsh.run` 数量 |
| `updateCheck` | `true` | 后台检查 GitHub 最新 Release |
| `updateCheckHours` | `6` | 自动检查间隔（小时，1–168） |

- 面板存在 `$DSH_HOME/dsh-pad/panels.json`；每个数据源最近一次成功读数和最近 20 个点存在同目录的 `readings.json`（只为重启后立刻有画面和趋势，可随时删除）；悬浮球位置、窗口位置 / 宽度 / 高度、嵌套分区和分隔比例按浏览器存在 localStorage。
- 每次 AI 刷新都是一个独立的 dsh 会话，工作目录是 `$DSH_HOME/dsh-pad/refresh`。dsh 目前不提供删除会话的接口，所以这些会话日志会留在 `$DSH_HOME/sessions/` 下对应这个目录的子目录里（每轮大约十几 KB）。它们不会出现在侧栏，需要清理时手动删除即可。
- 后台刷新的 agent 没有人在线审批，所以需要审批的工具调用（比如 workspace-write 模式下的 shell 命令）会被拒绝。AI 刷新适合用 web_fetch / web_search 取数；本机命令请用直接数据源。
- 在 dsh 0.2.1-rc.2 的 Web 界面（`dsh web`）与鲸屿桌面端上验证过：安装后宿主半激活、9 个 `pad_*` 工具注册、六个 `/api/dsh-pad.*` 路由可用，客户端面板坞在无头 Chrome 中渲染无异常。dsh 的插件 API 还在快速变化。悬浮坞挂在 dsh 的 `shell.overlay` 槽位；宽屏让位是给外框（`data-titlebar-density`）加 `padding-right`，右侧面板因此一起左移、不会被坞盖住；回合导航条则在 `@container` 里按对话宽度（≥ 800px）重新显示。dsh 以后改掉这些属性或类名，最坏也只是退化成纯悬浮、导航条按 dsh 自己的规则隐藏，不会坏。

```sh
npm install
npm run build      # lib/index.js（宿主半）+ lib/client.js（浏览器半，dsh 的闭包模块格式）
npm run watch
npm run typecheck

```
src/
  index.ts            宿主插件入口：配置、存储、调度、路由、工具
  host/

A floating panel plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh). Panels are written by the AI in the conversation: “make a panel that watches this server’s performance”, “make a panel that shows my DeepSeek API balance”.

- **Floating ball and free window**: collapsed, it is a draggable floating ball you can put anywhere in the app, and it snaps to the window edges when it gets close; click it to open the panel window. Drag the window’s title bar to place it anywhere, the left edge to set its width, the top or bottom edge to set its height (position and size are remembered in the browser). Sitting against the right edge, on wide screens it still makes room for the conversation, so neither the right-side panel nor the turn-navigation rail is covered.
- **AI-generated**: the model creates and edits panels through the `pad_*` tools. A panel is HTML / CSS / JS running in a sandboxed iframe, and its colors follow dsh’s light / dark theme.
- **Free splitting**: drag a card onto another card’s top / bottom / left / right edge to open a new region there, and keep nesting — two stacked on the left with one large standalone card on the right, for example. Drop on a card’s middle to swap the two cards’ places, drop on empty space in the dock to split it out into a full row. A panel is not a report; it is a 200–400px card: one number, a few rows, one trend. Three things keep it that way:

- **The panel kit**: the sandboxed iframe ships a set of `pad-*` classes (`.pad-metric`, `.pad-item`, `.pad-meter`, `.pad-status`, `.pad-spark`, …) plus generators such as `dsh.ui.metric` and `dsh.ui.list`. Every colour comes from a `--pad-*` token, so light and dark follow the host theme and a panel never hard-codes a colour.
- **The authoring manual**: `pad_guide` hands the model five layouts — single value with a trend, ranked rows, status board, quota ring, feed — and four complete `html` + `script` recipes, so it picks a layout before it writes code.
- **The layout lint**: `pad_create` / `pad_update` run a deterministic lint. A wall of text, a long paragraph, raw JSON pasted into the card, or text with nothing visual to anchor it is refused outright; hard-coded colours, tracked-caps labels and a script that never handles a failed source are reported as warnings.

Everything inside the card is still the model’s own HTML / CSS / JS — the kit is a starting point, and the lint rejects layouts that cannot be read, not a particular taste.

The panel design draws on the two kinds of panels in [ChisaBot](https://github.com/ChisaAlter/ChisaBot): sandboxed custom HTML panels, and live panels that a bot refreshes on a schedule.

Say what you want in the chat and the model builds the card with the `pad_*` tools. The three examples: server performance (a command source refreshing every 3 seconds), the latest release (an HTTP source parsing GitHub’s Atom feed), and an AI daily briefing (AI refresh).

Drop a card on another card’s top / bottom / left / right edge to open a new region there, and keep nesting — two stacked on the left with one large card on the right here. The splitter sets the ratio, with up to 3 cards per row. Collapsed, the dock is a floating ball you can drag anywhere; it snaps to the window edges, and one click opens the window again.
Card colors follow dsh’s light / dark theme, and the CSS variables inside the iframe switch with it.

Requires dsh ≥ 0.2.1-rc.2, on the Web UI (`dsh web`) or the Whale Isle desktop app.

The plugin is registered as a **bundle** (written into the profile’s `dsh.profile.bundles`). Do **not** copy the contents of this repository’s `cordis.patch.yml` into the profile’s `cordis.patch.yml` by hand: there is no matching module resolution there, and the whole app will fail to start.

```sh

readme.section: self-check first: is lib/ complete, are there leftovers in the profile?
readme.text: node scripts/doctor.mjs
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-pad

readme.section: from GitHub (the repo ships a built lib/, so no build script is needed)
readme.text:
dsh plugin --profile web add github:ChisaAlter/dsh-pad#v0.4.5
```

`lib/index.js` and `lib/client.js` are the only runtime entry points. The repository commits them to git precisely so that installing from GitHub does not depend on build scripts (pnpm refuses to run a dependency’s build scripts by default). If you change the source, run `npm install && npm run build` in the plugin directory first, then install.

readme.section: from GitHub (the repo ships a built lib/, so no build script is needed)
readme.text: Restart `dsh web` / Whale Isle after installing. To uninstall: `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-pad`.

After startup the plugin checks [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/ChisaAlter/dsh-pad/releases) in the background (every 6 hours by default, the first time about 7 seconds after startup). When a new version exists:

Transaction recovery applies to updates performed by 0.4.5 and later. Older updaters retain their old behavior while first upgrading to 0.4.5; install the complete version with the application closed for that transition.

If the current install is a **development-directory link** (the plugin directory has `.git/`), auto-update only reports the new version and never overwrites source code; run `git pull && npm run build` in the plugin directory instead. “Check again” in the update panel re-checks right away; set `updateCheck: false` to turn off background checks.

1. Open `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/package.json`, remove `"dsh-pad"` from `dsh.profile.bundles`, and remove `"dsh-pad"` from `dependencies`.
2. Open `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` and delete any entry that `insert`s `dsh-pad` (normally it should never appear there).
3. Delete `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-pad` (it is only a link).
4. Start again.
5. Before installing again, run `node scripts/doctor.mjs`; it tells you straight away whether `lib/` is missing, a link is missing, or the profile patch was written by hand.

Just say which panel you want in the conversation:

> Make a panel watching this server’s performance: CPU, memory, disk, load, refreshing every 3 seconds
>
> Make a panel showing my DeepSeek API balance, the key is in the environment variable DEEPSEEK_API_KEY
>
> Make a panel tracking the latest release of deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness, with the AI refreshing it every 6 hours

The **＋** at the top of the dock inserts a prompt — “create a custom panel with `pad_create`” — into the current conversation composer (it is not sent automatically); then write your requirements and send. When a new panel appears, the dock expands and highlights that card automatically.

Each card’s **⋯** menu holds: “Ask AI to change…” (fills the change request into the composer), undo last change, panel model, delete. Click a card title to fold it; a folded panel stops polling.

The **six-dot grip** at the top-left of each card can be dragged onto another card: dropping on the left / right edge splits into two columns, dropping on the top / bottom edge splits into two stacked regions, dropping in the middle swaps the two cards. Regions keep nesting — line up three cards in a row, then drag the middle one onto the bottom edge of the left card, and you get two stacked on the left plus one standalone card on the right.

```text
┌──────────────┬──────────────┐
│ CPU trend    │              │
├──────────────┤  Network IO  │
│ Memory       │              │

Drop a card on empty space in the dock and it splits out into a full row at the bottom. The vertical splitter between columns can be dragged to set the width ratio of the two neighboring columns; a new panel gets its own row at the bottom.

Each card has a thin bar at the bottom: drag it up or down to set the panel height, double-click to restore auto height; the height is stored per panel in the browser (localStorage) and survives a restart.

The dock itself: drag the title bar to put it anywhere on screen (the position is remembered in the browser), drag the left edge to set the width, drag the top or bottom edge to set its overall height (the panel list scrolls inside, double-click an edge for auto height, and the height is remembered in the browser too). Click the collapse button at the top and the dock becomes a floating ball; drag the ball anywhere with the mouse — it snaps to the window edges when close — and click it to expand again. The **＋** at the top creates a new panel.

- **Direct data sources** poll while a card or its focus view is visible in an expanded dock. Polling stops when no client watches it. Command and HTTP output is capped at 512KB, with a default timeout of 10 seconds; parsed JSON is limited to 64 nesting levels and 100,000 nodes.
- **The last value survives a restart**: the newest successful reading of every source, plus its last 20 points, are written to `$DSH_HOME/dsh-pad/readings.json` (coalesced into one write every 10 seconds; a JSON value over 16KB is not cached; one source's ring is capped at 128KB; a reading is dropped as soon as its source changes). The dock paints from it right away — trend charts start with that history — and the first poll continues from there; the file is only a cache, deleting it just makes panels wait for their first reading again.
- **Secrets**: `{{env:NAME}}` is resolved from dsh’s credential service first, then from the host process environment variables. Secret values appearing in error messages are replaced with `***`. HTTP requests carrying secret references, custom sensitive headers or a body only follow same-origin redirects; configure the trusted destination URL directly when a cross-origin r

| API | Description |
|---|---|
| `dsh.onData(fn)` | Called immediately when data is available, then again on every update. `data = { sources: { [id]: { ok, value, error, at } }, agent: { value, at } \| null }` |
| `dsh.history(id)` | The last 120 successful readings of that data source (accumulated while the page is open; after a restart it starts with the last 20 cached points), for trend charts |
| `dsh.refresh()` / `dsh.openUrl(url)` / `dsh.ask(text)` | Refresh now / open a link in a new tab / put a sentence into the conversation composer |
| `dsh.run(prompt, { system? })` | Run one pass with this panel’s model, returning `{ ok, text?, error? }`; plain text generation with no tools or network, handy for a button that processes the current data |
| `dsh.state.get(k)` / `dsh.state.set(k, v)` | Store a small amount of UI state per panel |
| `dsh.fmt.*` | `bytes` `percent` `number` `ago` `time` `duration` |
| `dsh.chart.*` | `sparkline` `bar` `ring`, returning SVG / HTML strings |
| `dsh.tone(x)` / `dsh.escape(s)` | ok / warn / danger colors by threshold / HTML escaping |

`dsh.run` does a single plain-text generation: prompts up to 24,000 characters, results up to 32,000 characters, a default 120-second timeout and 2048 output tokens; the model comes from the panel’s top-level `model`, or the global default without one. It calls no tools; to fetch data from the network, get it into the panel with a direct data source or AI refresh first, then hand it to `dsh.run`. `dsh.ask` still hands the sentence to the main conversation, not to the panel model.

Theme variables: `--pad-fg` `--pad-fg-2` `--pad-fg-3` `--pad-bg` `--pad-bg-2` `--pad-border` `--pad-accent` `--pad-ok` `--pad-warn` `--pad-danger` `--pad-font` `--pad-mono` `--pad-radius`.

The authoring manual lives in `src/host/guide.ts`: the short form rides along in the `pad_create` tool description, and the full manual (layouts, kit, recipes, dsh API) is served on demand by `pad_guide`.

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `pad_list` / `pad_get` | List panels / read the full definition and the latest data |
| `pad_guide` | The authoring manual: five layouts, kit classes, complete recipes, the `dsh` API, how to get data |
| `pad_test_source` | Try out a data source, to see the real output format before writing the script |
| `pad_create` / `pad_update` | Create / edit (pass only the fields to change); returns the lint result and the first readings |
| `pad_models` | List the provider / models / reasoning efforts available for panels, plus the global default model |
| `pad_refresh` | Refresh now and return the reading; use it to verify a panel after fixing it |
| `pad_delete` | Delete |

Override in `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` (a patch replaces the whole `config`, so write every key you need):

```yaml
- id: dsh-pad
  name: dsh-pad
  config:
    minIntervalSec: 2

| Key | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `dataFile` | `$DSH_HOME/dsh-pad/panels.json` | Where panels are stored |
| `minIntervalSec` | `2` | Shortest refresh interval for direct data sources (seconds) |
| `agentRefresh` | `true` | Whether AI-refresh panels are allowed |
| `minAgentMinutes` | `15` | Shortest AI refresh interval (minutes) |
| `agentTimeoutSec` | `300` | Longest single AI refresh turn |
| `agentConcurrency` | `1` | Number of AI refreshes running at the same time |
| `agentRetryMinutes` | `15` | Retry interval after a failed AI refresh |
| `interactiveModel` | `true` | Whether panel buttons may call the panel model through `dsh.run` |
| `runTimeoutSec` | `120` | Longest single `dsh.run` (seconds) |
| `runMaxTokens` | `2048` | Most tokens one `dsh.run` may generate |
| `runConcurrency` | `2` | Concurrent `dsh.run` calls on the same panel |
| `updateCheck` | `true` | Check GitHub for the latest Release in the background |
| `updateCheckHours` | `6` | Auto-check interval (hours, 1–168) |

- Panels are stored in `$DSH_HOME/dsh-pad/panels.json`; the newest successful reading of every source sits next to it in `readings.json` (only so a restart paints immediately, safe to delete); the ball’s position, the window’s position / width / height, the nested regions and the split ratios are stored per browser in localStorage.
- Every AI refresh is a separate dsh session whose working directory is `$DSH_HOME/dsh-pad/refresh`. dsh currently offers no API to delete sessions, so those session logs stay under `$DSH_HOME/sessions/`, in the subdirectory that corresponds to this directory (roughly a dozen KB per turn). They never show up in the sidebar, and you can delete them by hand when you want to clean up.
- The background refresh agent has no human online to approve anything, so any tool call that needs approval (a shell command under workspace-write mode, say) is rejected. AI refresh suits fetching data with web_fetch / web_search; use a direct data source for commands on this machine.
- Verified on dsh 0.2.1-rc.2’s Web UI (`dsh web`) and the Whale Isle desktop app: after install the host half is active, the 9 `pad_*` tools are registered, the six `/api/dsh-pad.*` routes work,

```sh
npm install
npm run build      # lib/index.js (host half) + lib/client.js (browser half, in dsh’s closure module format)
npm run watch
npm run typecheck

```
